     5	import AlgebraicJacobian.Picard.Pic0RankOneLocusNative
     6	import AlgebraicJacobian.Cohomology.GluedSheafH0BaseChange
     7	
     8	/-!
     9	# Degree-zero sections of the native rank-one module under coefficient change
    10	
    11	The glued datum already carries an unconditional ring-map equivalence on `H⁰`.
    12	This file transports that equivalence through `BasicOpenCocycleDatum.nativeModuleKSheafIso`,
    13	so the native `Scheme.Modules` object exposes the same comparison on its actual sections.
    14	The resulting map is an algebraic input to the canonical base-change mate; it does not assume
    15	that the mate itself is an isomorphism.
    16	-/
    17	
    18	set_option autoImplicit false
    19	
    20	universe u
    21	
    22	open CategoryTheory Limits Opposite TopologicalSpace
    23	open scoped TensorProduct
    24	
    25	namespace AlgebraicGeometry
    26	
    27	variable {k : Type u} [Field k]
    28	variable {C : Over (Spec (.of k))}
    29	variable {B : Type u} [CommRing B] [Algebra k B]
    30	variable {pi : C.left ⟶ P1 k} [IsAffineHom pi]
    31	
    32	namespace BasicOpenCocycleDatum
    33	
    34	noncomputable section
    35	
    36	variable (D : BasicOpenCocycleDatum C B pi)
    37	
    38	local instance nativeSectionsModule (U : (relCurve C B).Opens) :
    39	    Module B Γ(D.nativeModule, U) :=
    40	  Scheme.moduleKSections
    41	    (Over.mk (relCurve C B ↘ Spec (.of B))) D.nativeModule U
    42	
    43	/-- Degree-zero datum cohomology, viewed as native-module sections. -/
    44	noncomputable def nativeH0SectionsEquiv :
    45	    Sheaf.HModule D.sheaf 0 ≃ₗ[B] Γ(D.nativeModule, ⊤) :=
    46	  (Sheaf.HModule.linearEquiv₀
    47	      (Opens.grothendieckTopology ((relCurve C B : Scheme.{u}) : TopCat))
    48	      isTerminalTop D.sheaf).trans
    49	    (D.nativeModuleKSectionsEquiv (⊤ : (relCurve C B).Opens)).symm
    50	
    51	variable (B' : Type u) [CommRing B'] [Algebra k B'] [Algebra B B']
    52	  [IsScalarTower k B B']
    53	
    54	local instance nativeSectionsModuleBaseChange (U : (relCurve C B').Opens) :
    55	    Module B' Γ((D.baseChange B').nativeModule, U) :=
    56	  Scheme.moduleKSections
    57	    (Over.mk (relCurve C B' ↘ Spec (.of B'))) (D.baseChange B').nativeModule U
    58	
    59	/-- The native degree-zero base-change equivalence, obtained by transport from
    60	`datumH0BaseChange`; no `IsIso` statement is used as an input. -/
    61	noncomputable def nativeH0BaseChange
    62	    (hH1 : Subsingleton (datumPair D).H1) :
    63	    B' ⊗[B] Γ(D.nativeModule, ⊤) ≃ₗ[B']
    64	      Γ((D.baseChange B').nativeModule, ⊤) :=
    65	  ((D.nativeH0SectionsEquiv).symm.lTensor B').trans
    66	    ((D.datumH0BaseChange B' hH1).trans
    67	      ((D.baseChange B').nativeH0SectionsEquiv B').symm)
    68	
    69	@[simp]
    70	lemma nativeH0BaseChange_one_tmul
    71	    (hH1 : Subsingleton (datumPair D).H1) (x : Γ(D.nativeModule, ⊤)) :
    72	    D.nativeH0BaseChange B' hH1 (1 ⊗ₜ[B] x) =
    73	      ((D.baseChange B').nativeH0SectionsEquiv B')
    74	        (D.datumH0BaseChange B' hH1
    75	          (1 ⊗ₜ[B] (D.nativeH0SectionsEquiv).symm x)) := by
    76	  rfl
    77	
    78	end
    79	
    80	end BasicOpenCocycleDatum
    81	
    82	end AlgebraicGeometry

/-!
# The category of sheaves of modules over a scheme

In this file, we define the abelian category of sheaves of modules
`X.Modules` over a scheme `X`, and study its basic functoriality.

-/

@[expose] public section

universe t u

open CategoryTheory Limits TopologicalSpace SheafOfModules Bicategory

namespace AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme

variable {X Y Z T : Scheme.{u}}

variable (X) in
/-- The category of sheaves of modules over a scheme. -/
def Modules := SheafOfModules.{u} X.ringCatSheaf

namespace Modules

/-- Morphisms between `𝒪ₓ`-modules. Use `Hom.app` to act on sections. -/
def Hom (M N : X.Modules) : Type u := SheafOfModules.Hom M N

instance : Category X.Modules where
  Hom := Modules.Hom
  __ := (inferInstance : Category (SheafOfModules.{u} X.ringCatSheaf))

noncomputable instance : Abelian X.Modules :=
  inferInstanceAs <| Abelian (SheafOfModules.{u} X.ringCatSheaf)
instance : HasLimits X.Modules := inferInstanceAs (HasLimits (SheafOfModules X.ringCatSheaf))
instance : HasColimits X.Modules := inferInstanceAs (HasColimits (SheafOfModules X.ringCatSheaf))

section Functor

variable (X) in
/-- The forgetful functor from `𝒪ₓ`-modules to presheaves of modules.
This is mostly useful to transport results from (pre)sheaves of modules to `𝒪ₓ`-modules and
usually shouldn't be used directly when working with actual `𝒪ₓ`-modules. -/
def toPresheafOfModules : X.Modules ⥤ X.PresheafOfModules := SheafOfModules.forget _

/-- The forgetful functor from `𝒪ₓ`-modules to presheaves of modules is fully faithful. -/
def fullyFaithfulToPresheafOfModules : (Modules.toPresheafOfModules X).FullyFaithful :=
  SheafOfModules.fullyFaithfulForget _

instance : (toPresheafOfModules X).Full := fullyFaithfulToPresheafOfModules.full
instance : (toPresheafOfModules X).Faithful := fullyFaithfulToPresheafOfModules.faithful
instance : (toPresheafOfModules X).IsRightAdjoint :=
  (PresheafOfModules.sheafificationAdjunction (𝟙 X.ringCatSheaf.obj)).isRightAdjoint

variable (X) in
/-- The forgetful functor from `𝒪ₓ`-modules to presheaves of abelian groups. -/
noncomputable def toPresheaf : X.Modules ⥤ TopCat.Presheaf Ab X :=
  toPresheafOfModules X ⋙ PresheafOfModules.toPresheaf _

instance : (toPresheaf X).Faithful := .comp _ (PresheafOfModules.toPresheaf _)
instance : PreservesLimits (toPresheaf X) := comp_preservesLimits _ (PresheafOfModules.toPresheaf _)
instance : (toPresheaf X).ReflectsIsomorphisms :=
  reflectsIsomorphisms_comp _ (PresheafOfModules.toPresheaf _)

end Functor

variable {M N K : X.Modules} {φ : M ⟶ N} {U V : X.Opens}

section Presheaf

/-- The underlying abelian presheaf of an `𝒪ₓ`-module. -/
noncomputable def presheaf (M : X.Modules) : TopCat.Presheaf Ab X := M.1.presheaf

/-- Notation for sections of a presheaf of module. -/
scoped[AlgebraicGeometry] notation3 "Γ(" M ", " U ")" => (Scheme.Modules.presheaf M).obj (.op U)

instance : Module Γ(X, U) Γ(M, U) := (M.val.obj (.op U)).isModule

variable (M) in
@[simp] lemma map_smul (i : U ⟶ V) (r : Γ(X, V)) (x : Γ(M, V)) :
    M.presheaf.map i.op (r • x) = X.presheaf.map i.op r • M.presheaf.map i.op x :=
  M.val.map_smul _ _ _

/-- Scalar multiplication as an endomorphism of `Γ(M, U)`. -/
def smul : Γ(X, U) →+* End Γ(M, U) :=
  (M.val.obj (.op U)).smul

@[simp]
lemma smul_apply (r : Γ(X, U)) (x : Γ(M, U)) : (M.smul r).hom x = r • x := rfl

@[reassoc (attr := simp)]
lemma map_comp_smul (i : U ⟶ V) (r : Γ(X, V)) :
    M.smul r ≫ M.presheaf.map i.op = M.presheaf.map i.op ≫ M.smul (X.presheaf.map i.op r) := by
  ext
  simp

/-- The underlying map between abelian presheaves of a morphism of `𝒪ₓ`-modules. -/
noncomputable def Hom.mapPresheaf (φ : M ⟶ N) : M.presheaf ⟶ N.presheaf :=
  (toPresheaf X).map φ

/-- The application of a morphism of `𝒪ₓ`-modules to sections. -/
def Hom.app (φ : M ⟶ N) (U : X.Opens) : Γ(M, U) ⟶ Γ(N, U) :=
  (forget₂ _ _).map (φ.val.app (.op U))

@[simp] lemma mapPresheaf_app (φ : M ⟶ N) (U) : φ.mapPresheaf.app U = φ.app U.unop := rfl

@[simp]
lemma Hom.app_smul (φ : M ⟶ N) (r : Γ(X, U)) (x : Γ(M, U)) :
    φ.app U (r • x) = r • φ.app U x :=
  (φ.val.app (.op U)).hom.map_smul r x

@[simp] lemma Hom.add_app (φ ψ : M ⟶ N) : (φ + ψ).app U = φ.app U + ψ.app U := rfl
@[simp] lemma Hom.sub_app (φ ψ : M ⟶ N) : (φ - ψ).app U = φ.app U - ψ.app U := rfl
@[simp] lemma Hom.zero_app : (0 : M ⟶ N).app U = 0 := rfl
@[simp] lemma Hom.id_app (M : X.Modules) : (𝟙 M :).app U = 𝟙 _ := rfl
@[simp] lemma Hom.comp_app (φ : M ⟶ N) (ψ : N ⟶ K) : (φ ≫ ψ).app U = φ.app U ≫ ψ.app U := rfl

@[ext]
lemma hom_ext (f g : M ⟶ N) (H : ∀ U, f.app U = g.app U) : f = g := by
  apply SheafOfModules.hom_ext
  ext U x
  exact congr($(H U.unop) x)

lemma isSheaf (M : X.Modules) : M.presheaf.IsSheaf := SheafOfModules.isSheaf M

@[simp] lemma toPresheaf_obj : (toPresheaf X).obj M = M.presheaf := rfl
@[simp] lemma toPresheaf_map : (toPresheaf X).map φ = φ.mapPresheaf := rfl

set_option backward.isDefEq.respectTransparency false in
lemma Hom.isIso_iff_isIso_app {M N : X.Modules} {φ : M ⟶ N} :
    IsIso φ ↔ ∀ U, IsIso (φ.app U) := by
  rw [← isIso_iff_of_reflects_iso _ (toPresheaf X), NatTrans.isIso_iff_isIso_app]
  simp [Opposite.op_surjective.forall]

instance [IsIso φ] : IsIso (φ.app U) := Hom.isIso_iff_isIso_app.mp ‹_› _

@[simp, push ←]
lemma inv_app [IsIso φ] : (inv φ).app U = inv (φ.app U) := by
  apply IsIso.eq_inv_of_hom_inv_id
  simp [← Hom.comp_app]

end Presheaf

noncomputable section Functorial

variable (f : X ⟶ Y) (g : Y ⟶ Z) (h : Z ⟶ T)

/-- The pushforward functor for categories of sheaves of modules over schemes. -/
def pushforward : X.Modules ⥤ Y.Modules :=
  SheafOfModules.pushforward f.toRingCatSheafHom

@[simp]
lemma pushforward_obj_obj (M : X.Modules) (U : Y.Opens) :
    Γ((pushforward f).obj M, U) = Γ(M, f ⁻¹ᵁ U) := rfl

@[simp]
lemma pushforward_obj_presheaf_map {U V : Y.Opens} (i : U ⟶ V) :
    ((pushforward f).obj M).presheaf.map i.op = M.presheaf.map ((Opens.map f.base).map i).op := rfl

@[simp]
lemma pushforward_map_app (φ : M ⟶ N) (U : Y.Opens) :
    ((pushforward f).map φ).app U = φ.app (f ⁻¹ᵁ U) := rfl

/-- The pullback functor for categories of sheaves of modules over schemes. -/
def pullback : Y.Modules ⥤ X.Modules :=
  SheafOfModules.pullback f.toRingCatSheafHom

/-- The pullback functor for categories of sheaves of modules over schemes
is left adjoint to the pushforward functor. -/
def pullbackPushforwardAdjunction : pullback f ⊣ pushforward f :=
  SheafOfModules.pullbackPushforwardAdjunction _

section

attribute [local instance] preservesBinaryBiproducts_of_preservesBinaryCoproducts
  preservesBinaryBiproducts_of_preservesBinaryProducts

instance : (pullback f).IsLeftAdjoint := (pullbackPushforwardAdjunction f).isLeftAdjoint
instance : (pushforward f).IsRightAdjoint := (pullbackPushforwardAdjunction f).isRightAdjoint
instance : (pushforward f).Additive := Functor.additive_of_preservesBinaryBiproducts _
instance : (pullback f).Additive := Functor.additive_of_preservesBinaryBiproducts _

end

/-- The pushforward of sheaves of modules by the identity morphism identifies
to the identity functor. -/
def pushforwardId : pushforward (𝟙 X) ≅ 𝟭 _ :=
  SheafOfModules.pushforwardId _

@[simp] lemma pushforwardId_hom_app_app : ((pushforwardId X).hom.app M).app U = 𝟙 _ := rfl
@[simp] lemma pushforwardId_inv_app_app : ((pushforwardId X).inv.app M).app U = 𝟙 _ := rfl

variable (X) in
/-- The pullback of sheaves of modules by the identity morphism identifies
to the identity functor. -/
def pullbackId : pullback (𝟙 X) ≅ 𝟭 _ :=
  SheafOfModules.pullbackId _

variable (X) in
lemma conjugateEquiv_pullbackId_hom :
    conjugateEquiv .id (pullbackPushforwardAdjunction (𝟙 X)) (pullbackId X).hom =
      (pushforwardId X).inv :=
  SheafOfModules.conjugateEquiv_pullbackId_hom _

/-- The composition of two pushforward functors for sheaves of modules on schemes
identify to the pushforward for the composition. -/
def pushforwardComp :
    pushforward f ⋙ pushforward g ≅ pushforward (f ≫ g) :=
  SheafOfModules.pushforwardComp _ _

@[simp] lemma pushforwardComp_hom_app_app (U) : ((pushforwardComp f g).hom.app M).app U = 𝟙 _ := rfl
@[simp] lemma pushforwardComp_inv_app_app (U) : ((pushforwardComp f g).inv.app M).app U = 𝟙 _ := rfl

/-- The composition of two pullback functors for sheaves of modules on schemes
identify to the pullback for the composition. -/
def pullbackComp :
    pullback g ⋙ pullback f ≅ pullback (f ≫ g) :=
  SheafOfModules.pullbackComp _ _

/-- Pushforwards along equal morphisms are isomorphic. -/
def pushforwardCongr {f g : X ⟶ Y} (hf : f = g) : pushforward f ≅ pushforward g :=
    pushforwardNatIso _ (Opens.mapIso _ _ (hf ▸ rfl)) ≪≫
      SheafOfModules.pushforwardCongr (by cat_disch)

@[simp] lemma pushforwardCongr_hom_app_app {f g : X ⟶ Y} (hf : f = g) (U : Y.Opens) :
    ((pushforwardCongr hf).hom.app M).app U = M.presheaf.map (eqToHom (hf ▸ rfl)).op := rfl

@[simp] lemma pushforwardCongr_inv_app_app {f g : X ⟶ Y} (hf : f = g) (U : Y.Opens) :
    ((pushforwardCongr hf).inv.app M).app U = M.presheaf.map (eqToHom (hf ▸ rfl)).op := rfl

/-- Inverse images along equal morphisms are isomorphic. -/
def pullbackCongr {f g : X ⟶ Y} (hf : f = g) : pullback f ≅ pullback g :=
  eqToIso (hf ▸ rfl)

lemma conjugateEquiv_pullbackComp_inv :
    conjugateEquiv ((pullbackPushforwardAdjunction g).comp (pullbackPushforwardAdjunction f))
      (pullbackPushforwardAdjunction (f ≫ g)) (pullbackComp f g).inv =
    (pushforwardComp f g).hom :=
  SheafOfModules.conjugateEquiv_pullbackComp_inv _ _

@[reassoc]
lemma pseudofunctor_associativity :
    (pullbackComp f (g ≫ h)).inv ≫
      Functor.whiskerRight (pullbackComp g h).inv _ ≫ (Functor.associator _ _ _).hom ≫
        Functor.whiskerLeft _ (pullbackComp f g).hom ≫ (pullbackComp (f ≫ g) h).hom =
    eqToHom (by simp) := by
  let e₁ := pullbackComp f (g ≫ h)
  let e₂ := Functor.isoWhiskerRight (pullbackComp g h) (pullback f)
  let e₃ := Functor.isoWhiskerLeft (pullback h) (pullbackComp f g)
  let e₄ := pullbackComp (f ≫ g) h
  change e₁.inv ≫ e₂.inv ≫ (Functor.associator _ _ _).hom ≫ e₃.hom ≫ e₄.hom = _
  have : e₃.hom ≫ e₄.hom = (Functor.associator _ _ _).inv ≫ e₂.hom ≫ e₁.hom :=

lemma gluedRes_sectionsMap {V' V : (relCurve C B).Opens} (hV'V : V' ≤ V)
    {P' P : (relCurve C B').Opens} (hP : P ≤ relCurveMap C B B' ⁻¹ᵁ V)
    (hP' : P' ≤ relCurveMap C B B' ⁻¹ᵁ V') (hPP : P' ≤ P)
    (s : ↥(gluedSubmodule B D.pieces D.unit V)) :
    gluedRes B' (D.baseChange B').pieces (D.baseChange B').unit hPP
        (D.sectionsMap B' hP s) =
      D.sectionsMap B' hP' (gluedRes B D.pieces D.unit hV'V s) := by
  refine Subtype.ext (funext fun j => ?_)
  rw [gluedRes_coe, sectionsMap_coe, sectionsMap_coe, gluedRes_coe]
  exact (relCurveMap C B B').appLE_resHom
    (inf_le_inf_right (D.pieces j) hV'V) (D.sectionsMap_component_le B' hP j)
    (D.sectionsMap_component_le B' hP' j)
    (inf_le_inf_right ((D.baseChange B').pieces j) hPP) (s.val j)

/-- **The comparison intertwines the piece trivializations with `appLE`**: on an open
below a piece, trivializing the compared section is `appLE` of the trivialized
section. -/
lemma gluedTriv_sectionsMap (hW' : W' ≤ relCurveMap C B B' ⁻¹ᵁ W) {j : D.index}
    (hWj : W ≤ D.pieces j) (hW'j : W' ≤ (D.baseChange B').pieces j)
    (s : ↥(gluedSubmodule B D.pieces D.unit W)) :
    gluedTriv B' (D.baseChange B').isGluingCocycle j hW'j (D.sectionsMap B' hW' s) =
      ((relCurveMap C B B').appLE W W'
        (hW'.trans (Scheme.Hom.preimage_mono _ le_rfl))).hom
        (gluedTriv B D.isGluingCocycle j hWj s) := by
  rw [gluedTriv_apply, gluedTriv_apply, sectionsMap_coe]
  exact (relCurveMap C B B').appLE_resHom (le_inf le_rfl hWj)
    (D.sectionsMap_component_le B' hW' j) (hW'.trans (Scheme.Hom.preimage_mono _ le_rfl))
    (le_inf le_rfl hW'j) (s.val j)

/-- **The comparison intertwines the componentwise chart actions**: acting by
`r ∈ Γ(C_B, V)` then comparing equals comparing then acting by the compared scalar. -/
lemma sectionsMap_gluedQsmul {V : (relCurve C B).Opens} {V' : (relCurve C B').Opens}
    (hWV : W ≤ V) (hW' : W' ≤ relCurveMap C B B' ⁻¹ᵁ W)
    (hV' : V' ≤ relCurveMap C B B' ⁻¹ᵁ V) (hW'V' : W' ≤ V') (r : Γ(relCurve C B, V))
    (s : ↥(gluedSubmodule B D.pieces D.unit W)) :
    D.sectionsMap B' hW' (gluedQsmul B D.pieces D.unit hWV r s) =
      gluedQsmul B' (D.baseChange B').pieces (D.baseChange B').unit hW'V'
        (((relCurveMap C B B').appLE V V' hV').hom r) (D.sectionsMap B' hW' s) := by
  refine Subtype.ext (funext fun j => ?_)
  rw [sectionsMap_coe, gluedQsmul_coe, gluedQsmul_coe, sectionsMap_coe, map_mul]
  congr 1
  exact ((relCurveMap C B B').appLE_resHom (inf_le_left.trans hWV) hV'
    (D.sectionsMap_component_le B' hW' j) (inf_le_left.trans hW'V') r).symm

lemma isIso_of_coversTop (hX : K.CoversTop X) {F G : Sheaf K A} {f : F ⟶ G}
    (h : ∀ i, IsIso ((K.overPullback A (X i)).map f)) :

  rw [← ObjectProperty.isIso_hom_iff, NatTrans.isIso_iff_isIso_app]
  have hiso (Z : C) (i : ι) (g : Z ⟶ X i) : IsIso (f.hom.app (op Z)) :=
    (NatTrans.isIso_iff_isIso_app ((K.overPullback A (X i)).map f).hom).mp inferInstance
      (op (Over.mk g))
  intro W
  let S : K.Cover W.unop := hX.cover W.unop
  have harrow (I : S.Arrow) : IsIso (f.hom.app (op I.Y)) := by
    obtain ⟨i, ⟨g⟩⟩ := I.hf
    exact hiso I.Y i g

    F.property.amalgamate S (fun I => G.obj.map I.f.op ≫ inv (f.hom.app (op I.Y))) (by

      have hZ : IsIso (f.hom.app (op r.Z)) := by
        obtain ⟨i, ⟨g⟩⟩ := I₁.hf
        exact hiso r.Z i (r.g₁ ≫ g)

      rw [← Category.assoc, ← Category.assoc, ← G.obj.map_comp, ← G.obj.map_comp,
        ← op_comp, ← op_comp, r.w])
  refine ⟨⟨invMap, ?_, ?_⟩⟩
  · refine F.property.hom_ext S _ _ fun I => ?_
    simp only [op_unop, Category.assoc, Category.id_comp]
    rw [Presheaf.IsSheaf.amalgamate_map, ← f.hom.naturality_assoc]
    simp
  · refine G.property.hom_ext S _ _ fun I => ?_
    simp only [op_unop, Category.assoc, Category.id_comp]
    rw [← f.hom.naturality, Presheaf.IsSheaf.amalgamate_map_assoc]
    simp

/-- A sheaf morphism is an isomorphism iff it becomes one after pulling back along each
element of a covering family. -/

# Representably flat functors

We define representably flat functors as functors such that the category of structured arrows
over `X` is cofiltered for each `X`. This concept is also known as flat functors as in [Elephant]
Remark C2.3.7, and this name is suggested by Mike Shulman in

functor in the file `Mathlib/CategoryTheory/Functor/TypeValuedFlat.lean`).

This definition is equivalent to left exact functors (functors that preserves finite limits) when
`C` has all finite limits.

## Main results

* `flat_of_preservesFiniteLimits`: If `F : C ⥤ D` preserves finite limits and `C` has all finite
  limits, then `F` is flat.
* `preservesFiniteLimits_of_flat`: If `F : C ⥤ D` is flat, then it preserves all finite limits.
* `preservesFiniteLimits_iff_flat`: If `C` has all finite limits,
  then `F` is flat iff `F` is left exact.
* `lan_preservesFiniteLimits_of_flat`: If `F : C ⥤ D` is a flat functor between small categories,
  then the functor `Lan F.op` between presheaves of sets preserves all finite limits.
* `flat_iff_lan_flat`: If `C`, `D` are small and `C` has all finite limits, then `F` is flat iff

* `preservesFiniteLimits_iff_lanPreservesFiniteLimits`: If `C`, `D` are small and `C` has all

variable {C : Type u₁} [Category.{v₁} C] {D : Type u₂} [Category.{v₂} D]
variable {E : Type u₃} [Category.{v₃} E]

/-- A functor `F : C ⥤ D` is representably flat if the comma category `(X/F)` is cofiltered for
each `X : D`.
-/
class RepresentablyFlat (F : C ⥤ D) : Prop where
  cofiltered : ∀ X : D, IsCofiltered (StructuredArrow X F)

/-- A functor `F : C ⥤ D` is representably coflat if the comma category `(F/X)` is filtered for
each `X : D`. -/
class RepresentablyCoflat (F : C ⥤ D) : Prop where
  filtered : ∀ X : D, IsFiltered (CostructuredArrow F X)

attribute [instance] RepresentablyFlat.cofiltered RepresentablyCoflat.filtered

variable (F : C ⥤ D)

instance RepresentablyFlat.of_isRightAdjoint [F.IsRightAdjoint] : RepresentablyFlat F where
  cofiltered _ := IsCofiltered.of_isInitial _ (mkInitialOfLeftAdjoint _ (.ofIsRightAdjoint F) _)

instance RepresentablyCoflat.of_isLeftAdjoint [F.IsLeftAdjoint] : RepresentablyCoflat F where
  filtered _ := IsFiltered.of_isTerminal _ (mkTerminalOfRightAdjoint _ (.ofIsLeftAdjoint F) _)

theorem RepresentablyFlat.id : RepresentablyFlat (𝟭 C) := inferInstance

theorem RepresentablyCoflat.id : RepresentablyCoflat (𝟭 C) := inferInstance

/-- Being a representably flat functor is closed under natural isomorphisms. -/
theorem RepresentablyFlat.of_iso [RepresentablyFlat F] {G : C ⥤ D} (α : F ≅ G) :

  cofiltered _ := IsCofiltered.of_equivalence (StructuredArrow.mapNatIso α)

theorem RepresentablyCoflat.of_iso [RepresentablyCoflat F] {G : C ⥤ D} (α : F ≅ G) :
    RepresentablyCoflat G where

end

instance [RepresentablyCoflat F] : RepresentablyFlat F.op :=

/-- Restriction of an `𝒪ₓ`-module along an open immersion.
This is isomorphic to the pullback functor (see `restrictFunctorIsoPullback`)
but has better defeqs. -/
def restrictFunctor : Y.Modules ⥤ X.Modules :=
  letI α : X.presheaf ⟶ f.opensFunctor.op ⋙ Y.presheaf := { app U := (f.appIso U.unop).inv }
  SheafOfModules.pushforward (F := f.opensFunctor)
    ⟨Functor.whiskerRight α (forget₂ CommRingCat RingCat)⟩

/-- The restriction of a module along an open immersion. -/
abbrev restrict (M : Y.Modules) (f : X ⟶ Y) [IsOpenImmersion f] : X.Modules :=
  (restrictFunctor f).obj M

/-- The sections of the restriction of `M` over `U` are isomorphic to `Γ(M, f ''ᵁ U). -/
def restrictAppIso (M : Y.Modules) (U : X.Opens) : Γ(M.restrict f, U) ≅ Γ(M, f ''ᵁ U) :=
  Iso.refl _

@[elementwise (attr := simp), reassoc (attr := simp)]
lemma smul_restrictAppIso_hom (M : Y.Modules) (U : X.Opens) (r : Γ(X, U)) :
    dsimp% (M.restrict f).smul r ≫ (M.restrictAppIso f U).hom =
      (M.restrictAppIso f U).hom ≫ M.smul ((f.appIso U).inv r) :=
  rfl

@[elementwise (attr := simp), reassoc (attr := simp)]
lemma smul_restrictAppIso_inv (M : Y.Modules) (U : X.Opens) (r : Γ(Y, f ''ᵁ U)) :
    M.smul r ≫ (M.restrictAppIso f U).inv =
      (M.restrictAppIso f U).inv ≫ (M.restrict f).smul ((f.appIso U).hom r) := by
  simp [← cancel_mono (M.restrictAppIso f U).hom]

@[elementwise (attr := simp), reassoc (attr := simp)]
lemma map_restrictAppIso_hom (M : Y.Modules) {U V : X.Opens}

      (M.restrictAppIso f V).hom ≫
      M.presheaf.map (.op <| homOfLE <| Scheme.Hom.image_mono _ (leOfHom hUV.unop)) := by
  rfl

lemma restrictAppIso_inv_map (M : Y.Modules) {U V : X.Opens} (hUV : .op V ⟶ .op U) :

def restrictFunctorAdjCounitIso : pushforward f ⋙ restrictFunctor f ≅ 𝟭 _ :=
  letI := CategoryTheory.Functor.isContinuous_comp.{u} f.opensFunctor (Opens.map f.base)

      (fun U ↦ eqToIso (f.preimage_image_eq U).symm) fun _ ↦ rfl) ≪≫
    SheafOfModules.pushforwardCongr (by ext U x; exact
      congr($(f.appIso_inv_app_presheafMap U.unop) x)) ≪≫ SheafOfModules.pushforwardId _

/-- Restriction is right adjoint to pushforward. -/
def restrictAdjunction : restrictFunctor f ⊣ pushforward f := by
  refine pushforwardPushforwardAdj (by exact f.isOpenEmbedding.isOpenMap.adjunction) _ _ ?_ ?_
  · ext U x; exact congr($((f.app_appIso_inv _).symm).hom x)
  · ext U x
    have : (f.appIso U.unop).inv ≫ f.app _ ≫
      X.presheaf.map (eqToHom (f.preimage_image_eq U.unop).symm).op = 𝟙 _ := by
      rw [Scheme.Hom.appIso_inv_app_assoc, ← Functor.map_comp, ← X.presheaf.map_id]; rfl
    exact congr($this x)

1. Executive summary
The project has made real progress, especially in widened divisor-family infrastructure, rank calculations,
and finite-Galois descent machinery. However, the current code growth does not yet correspond to
comparable movement toward the final Picard representability theorem. The central reason is architectural:
large divisor degree gives coverage but destroys Abel-map injectivity, while genus degree gives rank-one
uniqueness but is harder to cover over an arbitrary base field.

The recommended route is therefore AJCR-first and follows the curve-specialized classical construction:
build a rank-one Picard open over a separably closed field, represent it by an open inside the degree-g
divisor scheme, cover the Picard functor by translations of this open, then descend the resulting Pic^0
through finite Galois descent. AJC should be used as the shared descent engine and long-term infrastructure
project rather than as a second independent Picard proof.

  Primary decision
  The next endpoint-critical theorem is the family-level natural isomorphism between the rank-one open
  inside Div^g and the rank-one open inside the Picard functor. Parameter decoupling remains useful
  infrastructure, but it is no longer the main Picard endpoint lane.

2. The three principal issues
2.1 Coverage degree and injectivity degree are incompatible
On a genus-g curve, a nonspecial divisor of degree n has h^0 = n + 1 - g. At a sufficiently large admissible
degree, coverage is available, but h^0 is greater than 1 in positive genus. The Abel map then has positive-
dimensional linear-system fibres and cannot directly be the monomorphism or open immersion required by
the existing Picard chart seam.

At degree n = g, the same rank formula gives h^0 = 1 on the nonspecial locus, so uniqueness and an open-
immersion chart become possible. However, the required degree-g translation data need not exist over an
arbitrary base field. The project has therefore been attempting to make two different parameter regimes
solve one seam.

    Parameter regime                   What it gives                       What fails

    n=g                                Rank-one fibres; potential open     Pointwise coverage over the original
                                       immersion                           base field

    n = admissible > g                 Uniform coverage and large-degree   Injectivity; the Abel fibres have h^0 >
                                       control                             1




2.2 Lean interfaces are hiding mathematical misalignment
Several classifier layers use one symbol for distinct semantic roles: curve genus, divisor degree, and window
parameters. Equivalent geometric objects are also represented by different Lean expressions, causing
expensive definitional-equality and typeclass-search failures. Weak existential witnesses and source/test-
locus mismatches have allowed locally true lemmas to accumulate without closing the intended producer.

      Hard-coded diagonal relation n = g in classifier and RepresentableBy layers.
      Repeated transports between relCurve-style and explicit base-change expressions.
      Duplicate diagonal and generalized proofs surviving in parallel.
      Fieldwise uniqueness results used where the consumer needs a natural inverse on arbitrary test
       schemes.
      Compatibility wrappers that move hypotheses but do not create the missing geometric map.

2.3 The final theorem chain is not yet closed
The repository contains many strong components, but the final path is still discontinuous. The missing
central theorem is not another rank or coverage lemma; it is a family-level identification of the correct
divisor open with the correct Picard open, followed by a complete descent theorem returning both the
descended scheme and its RepresentableBy certificate.

3. Binding architecture decision
3.1 Chosen route
Use the curve-specialized rank-one atlas over a separably closed field, then descend. The binding route is:

    rank-one open inside Div^g
        <-> rank-one Picard open
        -> translated open cover over k^s
        -> Pic^0 represented over k^s
        -> finite Galois descent
        -> Pic^0 represented over k




3.2 Role of the high-degree divisor lane
Complete one useful vertical arbitrary-degree representability spine, then freeze broad propagation unless a
named downstream theorem consumes it. This work remains valuable for divisor geometry, Brill-Noether
theory, projective-bundle descriptions, and a possible quotient fallback, but it should not be counted as
direct completion of the old Picard open-chart seam.

3.3 When a quotient route may be reconsidered
A large-degree Abel quotient should be reopened only after a non-circular Lean-shaped theorem contract is
written. The contract must construct a scheme quotient, prove its universal property, prove base-change
compatibility, and produce the desired map to the Picard functor without assuming Picard representability.
Merely defining equality of induced Picard class is not sufficient.

10. Phase 5 - Cover over a separably closed field
10.1 Translation theorem
Assume k is separably closed. For every extension K/k and every Picard class lambda on C_K, construct a line
bundle L0 on C/k such that the translated class has h^0 = 1 and h^1 = 0. The base-field origin of L0 is essential
because each translated open must itself be defined over k.

10.2 Formal proof strategy
5.    Twist by a sufficiently positive base-field line bundle until H^1 vanishes and H^0 is nonzero.
6.    If h^0 is greater than one, choose a k-rational point at which a nonzero section does not vanish.
7.    Subtract that point and use the exact sequence to lower h^0 by one while preserving H^1 = 0.
8.    Repeat until h^0 = 1.
9.    Return membership of the translated input class in PicRankOneOpen.

    theorem exists_translation_mem_picRankOneOpen
        [IsSepClosed k]
        (K : Type*) [Field K] [Algebra k K]
        (lam : picFunctor C (Spec K)) :
        exists L0 : LineBundle C,
          translate L0 lam in PicRankOneOpen C (Spec K)

3. Why the blocker is mathematically the right one
At a mathematical level, the gap is exactly the passage from pointwise/fibrewise information to a family
construction. Knowing that a line bundle has h0 = 1 and H1 = 0 after passing to fields is not, by itself,
enough to define the inverse Abel construction as a morphism on arbitrary test schemes.
   To construct a relative effective divisor canonically from a family of line bundles, the pushforward must
    behave as a rank-one locally free object on the relevant locus, not merely have one-dimensional fibres.
   The construction must commute with pullback. In Lean terms, the cartesian pushforward/base-change
    morphisms needed by the public API have to be IsIso in the precise hypotheses used by the family.
   The H0 rank-one statement and H1 vanishing must be tied to the same native presentation and
    transported coherently under arbitrary affine base change.
   Only then does the canonical section/evaluation divisor vary functorially and supply the inverse to the Abel
    map on the rank-one open locus.
   Consequently, a fieldwise translated-cover witness is a valid feeder, but it cannot replace the family-level
    representability/open-locus theorem. This is precisely why run 123 is correct to refuse that shortcut.

   176	        ((Scheme.Modules.pullbackPushforwardAdjunction g).unit.app N) V).hom x) = _

   184	/-- The canonical base-change mate sends the unit base-map image along `g`

   186	theorem canonicalBaseChangeMap_app_baseMap_compat
   187	    {X X' S S' : Scheme.{u}}
   188	    {f : X ⟶ S} {g : S' ⟶ S} {g' : X' ⟶ X} {f' : X' ⟶ S'}
   189	    (sq : IsPullback g' f' f g)
   190	    (F : X.Modules) {V : S.Opens} {U : S'.Opens}
   191	    (e : U ≤ g ⁻¹ᵁ V) (e' : f' ⁻¹ᵁ U ≤ g' ⁻¹ᵁ (f ⁻¹ᵁ V))

   193	    (((canonicalBaseChangeMap sq).app F).app U).hom
   194	        (pullback_app_isoTensor_baseMap g ((Scheme.Modules.pushforward f).obj F) e x) =
   195	      pullback_app_isoTensor_baseMap g' F e' x := by
   196	  have e₂ : f' ⁻¹ᵁ U ≤ (f' ≫ g) ⁻¹ᵁ V := by
   197	    rw [Scheme.Hom.comp_preimage]
   198	    exact fun a ha => e ha
   199	  have e₃ : f' ⁻¹ᵁ U ≤ (g' ≫ f) ⁻¹ᵁ V := by
   200	    rw [sq.w, Scheme.Hom.comp_preimage]
   201	    exact fun a ha => e ha
   202	  have h1 := pullback_app_isoTensor_baseMap_le_refl f'
   203	    ((Scheme.Modules.pullback g).obj ((Scheme.Modules.pushforward f).obj F)) U
   204	    (pullback_app_isoTensor_baseMap g ((Scheme.Modules.pushforward f).obj F) e x)

   207	  have h3 := pullback_app_isoTensor_baseMap_congr sq.w.symm

   210	    ((Scheme.Modules.pushforward f).obj F) (le_refl (f ⁻¹ᵁ V)) e' e₃ x

   212	        ((Scheme.Modules.pullback f).obj ((Scheme.Modules.pushforward f).obj F)),

   215	          ((Scheme.Modules.pushforward f).obj F)) (f' ⁻¹ᵁ U)).hom
   216	        ((Scheme.Modules.Hom.app ((Scheme.Modules.pullbackComp g' f).hom.app
   217	          ((Scheme.Modules.pushforward f).obj F)) (f' ⁻¹ᵁ U)).hom z) = z :=
   218	    fun z => congrArg
   219	      (fun (k : (Scheme.Modules.pullback f ⋙ Scheme.Modules.pullback g').obj

   221	          (Scheme.Modules.pullback f ⋙ Scheme.Modules.pullback g').obj

   235	    ((Scheme.Modules.pushforward f).obj F) V x
   236	  have h6b := congrArg
   237	    (fun (k : (Scheme.Modules.pushforward f).obj F ⟶
   238	        (Scheme.Modules.pushforward f).obj F) =>
   239	      (Scheme.Modules.Hom.app k V).hom x)

   242	      ((Scheme.Modules.pullbackPushforwardAdjunction f).counit.app F) (f ⁻¹ᵁ V)).hom

   244	        (le_refl (f ⁻¹ᵁ V)) x) = x :=
   245	    (congrArg (fun z => (Scheme.Modules.Hom.app
   246	      ((Scheme.Modules.pullbackPushforwardAdjunction f).counit.app F)
   247	      (f ⁻¹ᵁ V)).hom z) h6a).trans h6b

   249	        ((Scheme.Modules.pullbackPushforwardAdjunction f).counit.app F)) (f' ⁻¹ᵁ U)).hom
   250	      ((Scheme.Modules.Hom.app ((Scheme.Modules.pullbackComp g' f).inv.app
   251	          ((Scheme.Modules.pushforward f).obj F)) (f' ⁻¹ᵁ U)).hom
   252	        ((Scheme.Modules.Hom.app ((Scheme.Modules.pullbackCongr sq.w.symm).hom.app
   253	            ((Scheme.Modules.pushforward f).obj F)) (f' ⁻¹ᵁ U)).hom
   254	          ((Scheme.Modules.Hom.app ((Scheme.Modules.pullbackComp f' g).hom.app
   255	              ((Scheme.Modules.pushforward f).obj F)) (f' ⁻¹ᵁ U)).hom
   256	            ((Scheme.Modules.Hom.app
   257	                ((Scheme.Modules.pullbackPushforwardAdjunction f').unit.app
   258	                  ((Scheme.Modules.pullback g).obj
   259	                    ((Scheme.Modules.pushforward f).obj F))) U).hom
   260	              (pullback_app_isoTensor_baseMap g
   261	                ((Scheme.Modules.pushforward f).obj F) e x))))) =
   262	    pullback_app_isoTensor_baseMap g' F e' x
   263	  refine (congrArg (fun z =>
   264	    (Scheme.Modules.Hom.app ((Scheme.Modules.pullback g').map
   265	        ((Scheme.Modules.pullbackPushforwardAdjunction f).counit.app F)) (f' ⁻¹ᵁ U)).hom
   266	      ((Scheme.Modules.Hom.app ((Scheme.Modules.pullbackComp g' f).inv.app
   267	          ((Scheme.Modules.pushforward f).obj F)) (f' ⁻¹ᵁ U)).hom
   268	        ((Scheme.Modules.Hom.app ((Scheme.Modules.pullbackCongr sq.w.symm).hom.app
   269	            ((Scheme.Modules.pushforward f).obj F)) (f' ⁻¹ᵁ U)).hom
   270	          ((Scheme.Modules.Hom.app ((Scheme.Modules.pullbackComp f' g).hom.app
   271	              ((Scheme.Modules.pushforward f).obj F)) (f' ⁻¹ᵁ U)).hom z))))
   272	    h1.symm).trans ?_

   274	    (Scheme.Modules.Hom.app ((Scheme.Modules.pullback g').map
   275	        ((Scheme.Modules.pullbackPushforwardAdjunction f).counit.app F)) (f' ⁻¹ᵁ U)).hom
   276	      ((Scheme.Modules.Hom.app ((Scheme.Modules.pullbackComp g' f).inv.app
   277	          ((Scheme.Modules.pushforward f).obj F)) (f' ⁻¹ᵁ U)).hom
   278	        ((Scheme.Modules.Hom.app ((Scheme.Modules.pullbackCongr sq.w.symm).hom.app

     5	import AlgebraicJacobian.Picard.Pic0RankOneLocusNative
     6	import AlgebraicJacobian.Cohomology.GluedSheafH0BaseChange
     7	
     8	/-!
     9	# Degree-zero sections of the native rank-one module under coefficient change
    10	
    11	The glued datum already carries an unconditional ring-map equivalence on `H⁰`.
    12	This file transports that equivalence through `BasicOpenCocycleDatum.nativeModuleKSheafIso`,
    13	so the native `Scheme.Modules` object exposes the same comparison on its actual sections.
    14	The resulting map is an algebraic input to the canonical base-change mate; it does not assume
    15	that the mate itself is an isomorphism.
    16	-/
    17	
    18	set_option autoImplicit false
    19	
    20	universe u
    21	
    22	open CategoryTheory Limits Opposite TopologicalSpace
    23	open scoped TensorProduct
    24	
    25	namespace AlgebraicGeometry
    26	
    27	variable {k : Type u} [Field k]
    28	variable {C : Over (Spec (.of k))}
    29	variable {B : Type u} [CommRing B] [Algebra k B]
    30	variable {pi : C.left ⟶ P1 k} [IsAffineHom pi]
    31	
    32	namespace BasicOpenCocycleDatum
    33	
    34	noncomputable section
    35	
    36	variable (D : BasicOpenCocycleDatum C B pi)
    37	
    38	local instance nativeSectionsModule (U : (relCurve C B).Opens) :
    39	    Module B Γ(D.nativeModule, U) :=
    40	  Scheme.moduleKSections
    41	    (Over.mk (relCurve C B ↘ Spec (.of B))) D.nativeModule U
    42	
    43	/-- Degree-zero datum cohomology, viewed as native-module sections. -/
    44	noncomputable def nativeH0SectionsEquiv :
    45	    Sheaf.HModule D.sheaf 0 ≃ₗ[B] Γ(D.nativeModule, ⊤) :=
    46	  (Sheaf.HModule.linearEquiv₀
    47	      (Opens.grothendieckTopology ((relCurve C B : Scheme.{u}) : TopCat))
    48	      isTerminalTop D.sheaf).trans
    49	    (D.nativeModuleKSectionsEquiv (⊤ : (relCurve C B).Opens)).symm
    50	
    51	variable (B' : Type u) [CommRing B'] [Algebra k B'] [Algebra B B']
    52	  [IsScalarTower k B B']
    53	
    54	local instance nativeSectionsModuleBaseChange (U : (relCurve C B').Opens) :
    55	    Module B' Γ((D.baseChange B').nativeModule, U) :=
    56	  Scheme.moduleKSections
    57	    (Over.mk (relCurve C B' ↘ Spec (.of B'))) (D.baseChange B').nativeModule U
    58	
    59	/-- The native degree-zero base-change equivalence, obtained by transport from
    60	`datumH0BaseChange`; no `IsIso` statement is used as an input. -/
    61	noncomputable def nativeH0BaseChange
    62	    (hH1 : Subsingleton (datumPair D).H1) :
    63	    B' ⊗[B] Γ(D.nativeModule, ⊤) ≃ₗ[B']
    64	      Γ((D.baseChange B').nativeModule, ⊤) :=
    65	  ((D.nativeH0SectionsEquiv).symm.lTensor B').trans
    66	    ((D.datumH0BaseChange B' hH1).trans
    67	      ((D.baseChange B').nativeH0SectionsEquiv B').symm)
    68	
    69	@[simp]
    70	lemma nativeH0BaseChange_one_tmul
    71	    (hH1 : Subsingleton (datumPair D).H1) (x : Γ(D.nativeModule, ⊤)) :
    72	    D.nativeH0BaseChange B' hH1 (1 ⊗ₜ[B] x) =
    73	      ((D.baseChange B').nativeH0SectionsEquiv B')
    74	        (D.datumH0BaseChange B' hH1
    75	          (1 ⊗ₜ[B] (D.nativeH0SectionsEquiv).symm x)) := by
    76	  rfl
    77	
    78	end
    79	
    80	end BasicOpenCocycleDatum
    81	
    82	end AlgebraicGeometry

     6	import Mathlib.AlgebraicGeometry.Modules.Tilde
     7	
     8	/-!
     9	# Pullback of a tilde module along a morphism of affine schemes
    10	
    11	This file supplies the affine tensor dictionary needed by native pushforward base change.
    12	For a ring map `A \to B`, pullback along `Spec B \to Spec A` takes the tilde sheaf of an
    13	`A`-module to the tilde sheaf of its scalar extension to `B`.
    14	
    15	The proof uses uniqueness of left adjoints.  The only comparison required on the right-adjoint
    16	side is that global sections after pushforward along `Spec.map phi` are restriction of scalars
    17	along `phi`; on underlying sections this is restriction along `top <= (Spec.map phi) ^-1(top)`,
    18	which is the identity.
    19	-/
    20	
    21	set_option autoImplicit false
    22	
    23	universe u
    24	
    25	open CategoryTheory Limits TopologicalSpace Opposite
    26	
    27	namespace AlgebraicGeometry
    28	
    29	open Scheme Scheme.Modules
    30	
    31	set_option backward.isDefEq.respectTransparency false in
    32	private lemma modulesRestrictionPreimageTopEqId {X Y : Scheme.{u}} (g : Y ⟶ X)
    33	    (N : Y.Modules) (e : (⊤ : Y.Opens) ≤ g ⁻¹ᵁ ⊤) :
    34	    N.presheaf.map (homOfLE e).op = 𝟙 _ :=
    35	  (congrArg N.presheaf.map
    36	    (show (homOfLE e).op = 𝟙 (Opposite.op (⊤ : Y.Opens)) from rfl)).trans
    37	    (N.presheaf.map_id _)
    38	
    39	set_option backward.isDefEq.respectTransparency false in
    40	private lemma ringRestrictionPreimageTopEqId {X Y : Scheme.{u}} (g : Y ⟶ X)
    41	    (e : (⊤ : Y.Opens) ≤ g ⁻¹ᵁ ⊤) :
    42	    Y.presheaf.map (homOfLE e).op = 𝟙 _ :=
    43	  (congrArg Y.presheaf.map
    44	    (show (homOfLE e).op = 𝟙 (Opposite.op (⊤ : Y.Opens)) from rfl)).trans
    45	    (Y.presheaf.map_id _)
    46	
    47	set_option backward.isDefEq.respectTransparency false in
    48	private noncomputable def pullbackTildeGammaBridgeHom {A B : CommRingCat.{u}}
    49	    (phi : A ⟶ B) (N : (Spec B).Modules) :
    50	    (Scheme.Modules.pushforward (Spec.map phi) ⋙ moduleSpecΓFunctor (R := A)).obj N ⟶
    51	      (moduleSpecΓFunctor (R := B) ⋙ ModuleCat.restrictScalars phi.hom).obj N :=
    52	  ConcreteCategory.ofHom
    53	    { toFun := fun x =>
    54	        (N.presheaf.map (homOfLE (le_top :
    55	          (⊤ : (Spec B).Opens) ≤ Spec.map phi ⁻¹ᵁ ⊤)).op).hom x
    56	      map_add' := fun x y => map_add _ x y
    57	      map_smul' := fun a x =>
    58	        (Scheme.Modules.map_smul N (homOfLE (le_top :
    59	          (⊤ : (Spec B).Opens) ≤ Spec.map phi ⁻¹ᵁ ⊤))
    60	          (((Spec.map phi).app ⊤).hom ((Scheme.ΓSpecIso A).inv.hom a)) x).trans
    61	        (congrArg (fun r => r • (N.presheaf.map (homOfLE (le_top :
    62	            (⊤ : (Spec B).Opens) ≤ Spec.map phi ⁻¹ᵁ ⊤)).op).hom x)
    63	          ((congrArg (fun (k : Γ(Spec B, Spec.map phi ⁻¹ᵁ ⊤) ⟶ Γ(Spec B, ⊤)) =>
    64	              k.hom (((Spec.map phi).app ⊤).hom ((Scheme.ΓSpecIso A).inv.hom a)))
    65	            (ringRestrictionPreimageTopEqId (Spec.map phi) le_top)).trans
    66	           ((congrArg (fun (psi : A ⟶ Γ(Spec B, ⊤)) => psi.hom a)
    67	              (Scheme.ΓSpecIso_inv_naturality phi)).symm))) }
    68	
    69	set_option backward.isDefEq.respectTransparency false in
    70	private lemma pullbackTildeGammaBridgeHom_isIso {A B : CommRingCat.{u}}
    71	    (phi : A ⟶ B) (N : (Spec B).Modules) :
    72	    IsIso (pullbackTildeGammaBridgeHom phi N) := by
    73	  rw [ConcreteCategory.isIso_iff_bijective]
    74	  change Function.Bijective (fun x => (N.presheaf.map (homOfLE (le_top :
    75	    (⊤ : (Spec B).Opens) ≤ Spec.map phi ⁻¹ᵁ ⊤)).op).hom x)
    76	  rw [modulesRestrictionPreimageTopEqId (Spec.map phi) N le_top]
    77	  exact Function.bijective_id
    78	
    79	set_option backward.isDefEq.respectTransparency false in
    80	private noncomputable def pullbackTildeGammaBridge {A B : CommRingCat.{u}}
    81	    (phi : A ⟶ B) :
    82	    Scheme.Modules.pushforward (Spec.map phi) ⋙ moduleSpecΓFunctor (R := A) ≅
    83	      moduleSpecΓFunctor (R := B) ⋙ ModuleCat.restrictScalars phi.hom := by
    84	  refine NatIso.ofComponents
    85	    (fun N => @asIso _ _ _ _ _ (pullbackTildeGammaBridgeHom_isIso phi N))
    86	    (fun {N N'} h => ?_)
    87	  ext x
    88	  exact (congrArg (fun (k : Γ(N, Spec.map phi ⁻¹ᵁ ⊤) ⟶ Γ(N', ⊤)) => k.hom x)
    89	    ((Scheme.Modules.Hom.mapPresheaf h).naturality (homOfLE (le_top :
    90	      (⊤ : (Spec B).Opens) ≤ Spec.map phi ⁻¹ᵁ ⊤)).op)).symm
    91	
    92	set_option backward.isDefEq.respectTransparency false in
    93	/-- Pullback along `Spec.map phi` carries a tilde module to the tilde of scalar extension.
    94	
    95	This is the affine `pullback of tilde = tilde of tensor product` comparison (Stacks 01HQ).
    96	It is canonical: it is the uniqueness isomorphism between two left adjoints of global sections
    97	with restriction of scalars. -/
    98	noncomputable def Scheme.Modules.pullbackTildeIso {A B : CommRingCat.{u}}
    99	    (phi : A ⟶ B) :
   100	    tilde.functor A ⋙ Scheme.Modules.pullback (Spec.map phi) ≅
   101	      ModuleCat.extendScalars phi.hom ⋙ tilde.functor B :=
   102	  Adjunction.leftAdjointUniq
   103	    (((tilde.adjunction (R := A)).comp
   104	      (Scheme.Modules.pullbackPushforwardAdjunction (Spec.map phi))).ofNatIsoRight
   105	      (pullbackTildeGammaBridge phi))
   106	    ((ModuleCat.extendRestrictScalarsAdj phi.hom).comp (tilde.adjunction (R := B)))
   107	
   108	end AlgebraicGeometry

    11	/-!
    12	# Affine locality for native pushforward base change
    13	
    14	This file supplies two generic reductions used when proving that a canonical base-change mate is
    15	an isomorphism.
    16	
    17	* `Scheme.Modules.isIso_of_isIso_app_affine` upgrades isomorphisms on every affine open to an
    18	  isomorphism of sheaves of modules.  It uses the affine-open basis and stalks, and does not impose
    19	  quasi-coherence or finiteness hypotheses.
    20	* The two `of_fromTildeΓ` lemmas upgrade an isomorphism, or a bijection, on global sections of
    21	  `Spec R` once the source and target affine presentations `fromTildeΓ` are already known to be
    22	  isomorphisms.
    23	
    24	The latter hypothesis is deliberately explicit.  The pinned Mathlib does not provide the general
    25	affine equivalence between quasi-coherent modules on `Spec R` and `R`-modules, so these lemmas do
    26	not assert that quasi-coherence alone constructs the two affine presentations.
    27	-/
    28	
    29	set_option autoImplicit false
    30	
    31	universe u
    32	
    33	open CategoryTheory Limits TopologicalSpace
    34	
    35	namespace AlgebraicGeometry
    36	
    37	open Scheme Scheme.Modules
    38	
    39	-- The composite defining `e.hom` unfolds only below reducible transparency.
    40	set_option backward.isDefEq.respectTransparency false in
    41	/-- A morphism between two modules on `Spec R` with known affine presentations is an isomorphism
    42	as soon as its map on the corresponding global-sections modules is an isomorphism. -/
    43	theorem Scheme.Modules.isIso_of_isIso_moduleSpecGammaFunctor_map_of_fromTildeGamma
    44	    {R : CommRingCat.{u}} {M N : (Spec R).Modules}
    45	    [IsIso M.fromTildeΓ] [IsIso N.fromTildeΓ] (φ : M ⟶ N)
    46	    (h : IsIso ((moduleSpecΓFunctor (R := R)).map φ)) : IsIso φ := by
    47	  have key : M.fromTildeΓ ≫ φ =
    48	      (tilde.functor R).map ((moduleSpecΓFunctor (R := R)).map φ) ≫ N.fromTildeΓ :=
    49	    ((Scheme.Modules.fromTildeΓNatTrans (R := R)).naturality φ).symm
    50	  let iM := asIso M.fromTildeΓ
    51	  let iN := asIso N.fromTildeΓ
    52	  let iG := @asIso _ _ _ _ ((moduleSpecΓFunctor (R := R)).map φ) h
    53	  let e : M ≅ N := iM.symm ≪≫ (tilde.functor R).mapIso iG ≪≫ iN
    54	  have he : e.hom = φ :=
    55	    calc e.hom
    56	        = iM.inv ≫ ((tilde.functor R).map ((moduleSpecΓFunctor (R := R)).map φ) ≫
    57	            N.fromTildeΓ) := rfl
    58	      _ = iM.inv ≫ (M.fromTildeΓ ≫ φ) := by rw [key]
    59	      _ = φ := Iso.inv_hom_id_assoc iM φ
    60	  rw [← he]
    61	  exact e.isIso_hom
    62	
    63	-- The functor map and `Hom.app` are definitionally equal only after unfolding a non-reducible
    64	-- functor field.
    65	set_option backward.isDefEq.respectTransparency false in
    66	/-- Global-section form of
    67	`Scheme.Modules.isIso_of_isIso_moduleSpecGammaFunctor_map_of_fromTildeGamma`. -/
    68	theorem Scheme.Modules.isIso_of_bijective_appTop_of_fromTildeGamma
    69	    {R : CommRingCat.{u}} {M N : (Spec R).Modules}
    70	    [IsIso M.fromTildeΓ] [IsIso N.fromTildeΓ] (φ : M ⟶ N)
    71	    (h : Function.Bijective (Scheme.Modules.Hom.app φ (⊤ : (Spec R).Opens))) :
    72	    IsIso φ := by
    73	  refine Scheme.Modules.isIso_of_isIso_moduleSpecGammaFunctor_map_of_fromTildeGamma φ ?_
    74	  rw [ConcreteCategory.isIso_iff_bijective]
    75	  have hfun : ⇑(ConcreteCategory.hom ((moduleSpecΓFunctor (R := R)).map φ)) =
    76	      ⇑(ConcreteCategory.hom (Scheme.Modules.Hom.app φ (⊤ : (Spec R).Opens))) := rfl

    80	/-- A morphism of scheme modules is an isomorphism if its section map is an isomorphism on every
    81	affine open.  The proof computes stalks on the affine-open basis, then reflects the resulting
    82	isomorphism of underlying abelian sheaves. -/
    83	theorem Scheme.Modules.isIso_of_isIso_app_affine
    84	    {X : Scheme.{u}} {M N : X.Modules} (φ : M ⟶ N)
    85	    (h : ∀ (U : X.Opens), IsAffineOpen U → IsIso (φ.app U)) :
    86	    IsIso φ := by
    87	  let f := (SheafOfModules.toSheaf.{u} X.ringCatSheaf).map φ
    88	  have happ (U : X.Opens) (hU : U ∈ X.affineOpens) :
    89	      IsIso (f.hom.app (.op U)) := by
    90	    dsimp [f]
    91	    exact h U hU
    92	  have hstalk (x : X) :
    93	      IsIso ((TopCat.Presheaf.stalkFunctor Ab x).map f.hom) := by
    94	    rw [ConcreteCategory.isIso_iff_bijective]
    95	    constructor
    96	    · apply TopCat.Presheaf.stalkFunctor_map_injective_of_isBasis X.isBasis_affineOpens
    97	      intro U hU
    98	      exact (ConcreteCategory.isIso_iff_bijective (f.hom.app (.op U))).mp
    99	        (happ U hU) |>.1
   100	    · intro t
   101	      obtain ⟨U, hxU, hU, s, rfl⟩ :=
   102	        TopCat.Presheaf.exists_mem_germ_eq_of_isBasis X.isBasis_affineOpens
   103	          (TopCat.Sheaf.presheaf ((SheafOfModules.toSheaf.{u} X.ringCatSheaf).obj N)) x t
   104	      letI : IsIso (f.hom.app (.op U)) := happ U hU
   105	      refine ⟨(TopCat.Sheaf.presheaf
   106	          ((SheafOfModules.toSheaf.{u} X.ringCatSheaf).obj M)).germ U x hxU
   107	        (inv (f.hom.app (.op U)) s), ?_⟩
   108	      rw [TopCat.Presheaf.stalkFunctor_map_germ_apply]
   109	      simp
   110	  letI (x : X) := hstalk x
   111	  haveI : IsIso f := TopCat.Presheaf.isIso_of_stalkFunctor_map_iso f
   112	  haveI : IsIso ((Scheme.Modules.toPresheaf X).map φ) := by
   113	    change IsIso f.hom
   114	    infer_instance
   115	  exact isIso_of_reflects_iso φ (Scheme.Modules.toPresheaf X)

   118	every affine open of the target scheme `S'`. -/
   119	theorem isIso_canonicalBaseChangeMap_app_of_affine
   120	    {X X' S S' : Scheme.{u}}
   121	    {f : X ⟶ S} {g : S' ⟶ S} {g' : X' ⟶ X} {f' : X' ⟶ S'}
   122	    (sq : IsPullback g' f' f g) (M : X.Modules)
   123	    (h : ∀ (U : S'.Opens), IsAffineOpen U →
   124	      IsIso (((canonicalBaseChangeMap sq).app M).app U)) :
   125	    IsIso ((canonicalBaseChangeMap sq).app M) := by
   126	  exact Scheme.Modules.isIso_of_isIso_app_affine _ h

     8	/-!
     9	# Base change of the pinned cocycle datum (DAT-1, stage 1d-ii, the datum half)
    10	
    11	The `relCocycleBaseChange`-style base change of the basic-open cocycle datum
    12	(`informal/spec-dat-1.md` stage (1d-ii), first bullet; worksheet §3.2 — **this is the
    13	RE-5 transport interface**): along a `k`-algebra map `B → B'`, the generators, partition
    14	coefficients and transition units of a `Scheme.BasicOpenCocycleDatum C B π` push forward
    15	through the relative-curve comparison morphism `relCurveMap C B B'` to a datum over `B'`,
    16	with the pieces mapping to pieces (`Scheme.preimage_basicOpen`) and the partition/cocycle
    17	identities carried by `map_*`.
    18	
    19	* `AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.Hom.appLE_resHom` — `appLE` commutes with restriction on
    20	  both sides (the workhorse; both sides collapse to one `appLE` by
    21	  `appLE_map`/`map_appLE` and proof irrelevance).
    22	* `relSectionsMap_basicOpen` — basic opens of compared sections are preimages of basic
    23	  opens.
    24	* `relCurveMap_appLE_overAlgebraMap` — the comparison intertwines the structure algebra
    25	  maps along `algebraMap B B'`, over **arbitrary** opens (the pullback-open case is the
    26	  landed `relSectionsMap_overAlgebraMap`).
    27	* `BasicOpenCoverData.baseChange` / `BasicOpenCocycleDatum.baseChange` — the datum base
    28	  change, with `pieces_baseChange` (pieces map to pieces).
    29	* `BasicOpenCocycleDatum.sectionsMap` — the componentwise comparison of glued sections
    30	  `F_D(W) → F_{D'}(W')` for `W' ≤ relCurveMap ⁻¹ᵁ W`, additive
    31	  (`sectionsMap_add`), semilinear along `algebraMap B B'` (`sectionsMap_smul`),
    32	  commuting with restriction (`gluedRes_sectionsMap`), intertwining the piece
    33	  trivializations with the section comparison (`gluedTriv_sectionsMap`) and the
    34	  componentwise chart actions (`sectionsMap_gluedQsmul`) — the inputs of the stage
    35	  (1d-ii) term identifications and the RE-5 transport.
    36	-/

    50	/-! ## `appLE` against restriction, on arbitrary opens -/
    51	
    52	/-- **`appLE` commutes with restriction**: for `f : X ⟶ Y`, restricting the `appLE`
    53	image of a section equals the `appLE` image of the restricted section. Both sides are
    54	`f.appLE W PW'` of the section, by `appLE_map`/`map_appLE` and proof irrelevance of the
    55	inclusion witnesses. -/
    56	lemma Scheme.Hom.appLE_resHom {X Y : Scheme.{u}} (f : X.Hom Y) {W' W : Y.Opens}
    57	    {PW' PW : X.Opens} (hW : W' ≤ W) (ePW : PW ≤ f ⁻¹ᵁ W) (ePW' : PW' ≤ f ⁻¹ᵁ W')
    58	    (hP : PW' ≤ PW) (s : Γ(Y, W)) :
    59	    X.resHom hP ((f.appLE W PW ePW).hom s) =
    60	      (f.appLE W' PW' ePW').hom (Y.resHom hW s) := by
    61	  have h1 := congr((CommRingCat.Hom.hom
    62	    $(Scheme.Hom.appLE_map f ePW (homOfLE hP).op)) s)
    63	  have h2 := congr((CommRingCat.Hom.hom
    64	    $(Scheme.Hom.map_appLE f ePW' (homOfLE hW).op)) s)
    65	  exact h1.trans h2.symm
    66	
    67	section BasicOpen
    68	
    69	variable {k : Type u} [Field k] (C : Over (Spec (.of k)))
    70	variable (B : Type u) [CommRing B] [Algebra k B]
    71	variable (B' : Type u) [CommRing B'] [Algebra k B'] [Algebra B B'] [IsScalarTower k B B']
    72	
    73	/-! ## Basic opens of compared sections -/
    74	
    75	/-- **Basic opens base-change to basic opens**: the basic open of the compared section
    76	`relSectionsMap s` is the `relCurveMap`-preimage of the basic open of `s`. -/
    77	theorem relSectionsMap_basicOpen (V : C.left.Opens)
    78	    (s : Γ(relCurve C B, (fst C (overSpec k B)).left ⁻¹ᵁ V)) :
    79	    (relCurve C B').basicOpen (relSectionsMap C B B' V s) =
    80	      relCurveMap C B B' ⁻¹ᵁ ((relCurve C B).basicOpen s) := by
    81	  have happ : relSectionsMap C B B' V s =
    82	      (relCurve C B').resHom
    83	        (le_of_eq (relCurveMap_preimage C B B' V).symm :
    84	          (fst C (overSpec k B')).left ⁻¹ᵁ V ≤
    85	            relCurveMap C B B' ⁻¹ᵁ ((fst C (overSpec k B)).left ⁻¹ᵁ V))
    86	        (((relCurveMap C B B').app ((fst C (overSpec k B)).left ⁻¹ᵁ V)).hom s) := by
    87	    have h := congr((CommRingCat.Hom.hom
    88	      $(Scheme.Hom.appLE_map (relCurveMap C B B')
    89	        (le_refl (relCurveMap C B B' ⁻¹ᵁ ((fst C (overSpec k B)).left ⁻¹ᵁ V)))
    90	        (homOfLE (le_of_eq (relCurveMap_preimage C B B' V).symm)).op)) s)
    91	    have h0 : ((relCurveMap C B B').appLE ((fst C (overSpec k B)).left ⁻¹ᵁ V)
    92	        (relCurveMap C B B' ⁻¹ᵁ ((fst C (overSpec k B)).left ⁻¹ᵁ V)) le_rfl).hom s =
    93	        (((relCurveMap C B B').app ((fst C (overSpec k B)).left ⁻¹ᵁ V)).hom s) :=
    94	      congr((CommRingCat.Hom.hom
    95	        $(Scheme.Hom.appLE_eq_app (relCurveMap C B B')
    96	          (U := (fst C (overSpec k B)).left ⁻¹ᵁ V))) s)
    97	    calc relSectionsMap C B B' V s
    98	        = ((relCurveMap C B B').appLE ((fst C (overSpec k B)).left ⁻¹ᵁ V)
    99	            ((fst C (overSpec k B')).left ⁻¹ᵁ V)
   100	            (le_of_eq (relCurveMap_preimage C B B' V).symm)).hom s := rfl
   101	      _ = (relCurve C B').resHom (le_of_eq (relCurveMap_preimage C B B' V).symm)
   102	            (((relCurveMap C B B').appLE ((fst C (overSpec k B)).left ⁻¹ᵁ V)
   103	              (relCurveMap C B B' ⁻¹ᵁ ((fst C (overSpec k B)).left ⁻¹ᵁ V))
   104	              le_rfl).hom s) := h.symm
   105	      _ = _ := by rw [h0]
   106	  rw [happ, Scheme.basicOpen_resHom,
   107	    ← Scheme.preimage_basicOpen (relCurveMap C B B') s,
   108	    ← relCurveMap_preimage C B B' V, ← Scheme.Hom.preimage_inf]
   109	  congr 1
   110	  exact inf_eq_right.mpr ((relCurve C B).basicOpen_le s)
   111	
   112	/-! ## The comparison intertwines the structure algebra maps (arbitrary opens) -/
   113	
   114	/-- `appLE` is invariant under an equality of morphisms. -/
   115	private lemma appLE_congr_hom {X Y : Scheme.{u}} {f g : X ⟶ Y} (h : f = g) {U : Y.Opens}
   116	    {W : X.Opens} (e : W ≤ f ⁻¹ᵁ U) :
   117	    f.appLE U W e = g.appLE U W (h ▸ e) := by
   118	  subst h; rfl
   119	
   120	attribute [local instance] Scheme.overModule
   121	
   122	/-- **The comparison intertwines the structure actions, on arbitrary opens**: the
   123	`appLE` image of the structure pullback of `r : B` is the structure pullback of
   124	`algebraMap B B' r` (the landed `relSectionsMap_overAlgebraMap` is the pullback-open
   125	case `W = V_B`). -/
   126	theorem relCurveMap_appLE_overAlgebraMap {W : (relCurve C B).Opens}
   127	    {W' : (relCurve C B').Opens} (hle : W' ≤ relCurveMap C B B' ⁻¹ᵁ W) (r : B) :
   128	    ((relCurveMap C B B').appLE W W' hle).hom
   129	        ((relCurve C B).overAlgebraMap B W r) =
   130	      (relCurve C B').overAlgebraMap B' W' (algebraMap B B' r) := by
   131	  have hmor : ((Scheme.ΓSpecIso (.of B)).inv ≫
   132	        (snd C (overSpec k B)).left.appLE ⊤ W
   133	          (le_top.trans (Scheme.Hom.preimage_top (snd C (overSpec k B)).left).ge)) ≫
   134	      (relCurveMap C B B').appLE W W' hle =
   135	      CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap B B') ≫ (Scheme.ΓSpecIso (.of B')).inv ≫
   136	        (snd C (overSpec k B')).left.appLE ⊤ W'
   137	          (le_top.trans (Scheme.Hom.preimage_top (snd C (overSpec k B')).left).ge) := by
   138	    have hnat : (Scheme.ΓSpecIso (.of B)).inv ≫
   139	        (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap B B'))).appTop =
   140	        CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap B B') ≫ (Scheme.ΓSpecIso (.of B')).inv := by
   141	      rw [Iso.inv_comp_eq, ← Category.assoc,
   142	        ← Scheme.ΓSpecIso_naturality (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap B B')),
   143	        Category.assoc, Iso.hom_inv_id, Category.comp_id]
   144	    have hsplit : ((snd C (overSpec k B')).left ≫
   145	          Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap B B'))).appLE ⊤ W'
   146	          ((relCurveMap_snd C B B') ▸
   147	            hle.trans (Scheme.Hom.preimage_mono _ (le_top.trans
   148	              (Scheme.Hom.preimage_top (snd C (overSpec k B)).left).ge))) =
   149	        (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap B B'))).appLE ⊤ ⊤
   150	            (Scheme.Hom.preimage_top _).ge ≫
   151	          (snd C (overSpec k B')).left.appLE ⊤ W'
   152	            (le_top.trans (Scheme.Hom.preimage_top (snd C (overSpec k B')).left).ge) :=
   153	      (Scheme.Hom.appLE_comp_appLE _ _ _ _ _ _ _).symm
   154	    have happ : (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap B B'))).appLE ⊤ ⊤
   155	        (Scheme.Hom.preimage_top _).ge =
   156	        (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap B B'))).appTop :=
   157	      Scheme.Hom.appLE_eq_app _
   158	    rw [Category.assoc, Scheme.Hom.appLE_comp_appLE,
   159	      appLE_congr_hom (relCurveMap_snd C B B'), hsplit, happ, ← Category.assoc,
   160	      hnat, Category.assoc]
   161	  have hoam : (relCurve C B).overAlgebraMap B W r =
   162	      ((Scheme.ΓSpecIso (.of B)).inv ≫
   163	        (snd C (overSpec k B)).left.appLE ⊤ W
   164	          (le_top.trans (Scheme.Hom.preimage_top (snd C (overSpec k B)).left).ge)).hom
   165	        r := rfl
   166	  have hoam' : (relCurve C B').overAlgebraMap B' W' (algebraMap B B' r) =
   167	      ((Scheme.ΓSpecIso (.of B')).inv ≫
   168	        (snd C (overSpec k B')).left.appLE ⊤ W'
   169	          (le_top.trans (Scheme.Hom.preimage_top (snd C (overSpec k B')).left).ge)).hom
   170	        (algebraMap B B' r) := rfl
   171	  rw [hoam, hoam']
   172	  exact congr((CommRingCat.Hom.hom $hmor) r)

   178	section Datum
   179	
   180	variable {k : Type u} [Field k] {C : Over (Spec (.of k))}
   181	variable {B : Type u} [CommRing B] [Algebra k B]
   182	variable (B' : Type u) [CommRing B'] [Algebra k B'] [Algebra B B'] [IsScalarTower k B B']
   183	variable {π : C.left ⟶ P1 k} [IsAffineHom π]

   185	attribute [local instance] Scheme.overModule

   187	namespace BasicOpenCoverData
   188	
   189	variable (D : BasicOpenCoverData C B π)
   190	
   191	/-- **Base change of the basic-open cover data** along `B → B'`: the generators and
   192	partition coefficients push forward through the sections comparison map; the partition
   193	witnesses are carried by `map_sum`/`map_mul`/`map_one`. -/
   194	noncomputable def baseChange : BasicOpenCoverData C B' π where
   195	  J₀ := D.J₀
   196	  J₁ := D.J₁
   197	  fintype₀ := D.fintype₀
   198	  fintype₁ := D.fintype₁
   199	  h₀ j := relSectionsMap C B B' (fiberChart₀ π) (D.h₀ j)
   200	  h₁ j := relSectionsMap C B B' (fiberChart₁ π) (D.h₁ j)
   201	  a₀ j := relSectionsMap C B B' (fiberChart₀ π) (D.a₀ j)
   202	  a₁ j := relSectionsMap C B B' (fiberChart₁ π) (D.a₁ j)
   203	  partition₀ := by
   204	    have h := congrArg (relSectionsMap C B B' (fiberChart₀ π)) D.partition₀
   205	    rw [map_sum, map_one] at h
   206	    rw [← h]
   207	    exact Finset.sum_congr rfl fun j _ => (map_mul _ _ _).symm
   208	  partition₁ := by
   209	    have h := congrArg (relSectionsMap C B B' (fiberChart₁ π)) D.partition₁
   210	    rw [map_sum, map_one] at h
   211	    rw [← h]
   212	    exact Finset.sum_congr rfl fun j _ => (map_mul _ _ _).symm
   213	
   214	@[simp]
   215	lemma baseChange_h₀ (j : D.J₀) :
   216	    (D.baseChange B').h₀ j = relSectionsMap C B B' (fiberChart₀ π) (D.h₀ j) := rfl
   217	
   218	@[simp]
   219	lemma baseChange_h₁ (j : D.J₁) :
   220	    (D.baseChange B').h₁ j = relSectionsMap C B B' (fiberChart₁ π) (D.h₁ j) := rfl
   221	
   222	/-- **Pieces base-change to pieces**: the pieces of the base-changed cover data are the
   223	`relCurveMap`-preimages of the pieces. -/
   224	theorem pieces_baseChange (j : D.index) :
   225	    (D.baseChange B').pieces j = relCurveMap C B B' ⁻¹ᵁ D.pieces j := by
   226	  cases j with
   227	  | inl j => exact relSectionsMap_basicOpen C B B' (fiberChart₀ π) (D.h₀ j)
   228	  | inr j => exact relSectionsMap_basicOpen C B B' (fiberChart₁ π) (D.h₁ j)
   229	
   230	/-- The base-changed pieces are below the preimages of the pieces (the `≤`-form of
   231	`pieces_baseChange` consumed by `appLE`). -/
   232	lemma baseChange_pieces_le_preimage (j : D.index) :
   233	    (D.baseChange B').pieces j ≤ relCurveMap C B B' ⁻¹ᵁ D.pieces j :=
   234	  (D.pieces_baseChange B' j).le
   235	
   236	/-- Double overlaps of base-changed pieces are below the preimages of the double
   237	overlaps. -/
   238	lemma baseChange_inf_le_preimage (i j : D.index) :
   239	    (D.baseChange B').pieces i ⊓ (D.baseChange B').pieces j ≤
   240	      relCurveMap C B B' ⁻¹ᵁ (D.pieces i ⊓ D.pieces j) := by
   241	  rw [Scheme.Hom.preimage_inf]
   242	  exact inf_le_inf (D.baseChange_pieces_le_preimage B' i)
   243	    (D.baseChange_pieces_le_preimage B' j)
   244	
   245	/-- **The overlap comparison map**: sections on a double overlap of pieces compare to
   246	sections on the double overlap of the base-changed pieces, through `appLE` of the
   247	relative-curve comparison. -/
   248	noncomputable def overlapMap (i j : D.index) :
   249	    Γ(relCurve C B, D.pieces i ⊓ D.pieces j) →+*
   250	      Γ(relCurve C B', (D.baseChange B').pieces i ⊓ (D.baseChange B').pieces j) :=
   251	  ((relCurveMap C B B').appLE (D.pieces i ⊓ D.pieces j)
   252	    ((D.baseChange B').pieces i ⊓ (D.baseChange B').pieces j)
   253	    (D.baseChange_inf_le_preimage B' i j)).hom
   254	
   255	end BasicOpenCoverData

   257	namespace BasicOpenCocycleDatum
   258	
   259	variable (D : BasicOpenCocycleDatum C B π)
   260	
   261	/-- **Base change of the pinned cocycle datum** along `B → B'` (stage (1d-ii), the
   262	datum half; the RE-5 descent/transport interface): generators, partition coefficients
   263	and transition units push forward through the relative-curve comparison; the cocycle
   264	identities are carried by ring-hom functoriality (`Scheme.Hom.appLE_resHom`). -/
   265	noncomputable def baseChange : BasicOpenCocycleDatum C B' π where
   266	  toBasicOpenCoverData := D.toBasicOpenCoverData.baseChange B'
   267	  unit i j := Units.map (D.toBasicOpenCoverData.overlapMap B' i j).toMonoidHom
   268	    (D.unit i j)
   269	  isGluingCocycle := by
   270	    constructor
   271	    · intro i
   272	      have h := D.isGluingCocycle.unit_self i
   273	      change (D.toBasicOpenCoverData.overlapMap B' i i)
   274	        ((D.unit i i : Γ(relCurve C B, D.pieces i ⊓ D.pieces i))) = 1
   275	      rw [h, map_one]
   276	    · intro i j l
   277	      -- the triple overlap of the base-changed pieces sits below the preimage of the
   278	      -- triple overlap
   279	      have htriple : (D.toBasicOpenCoverData.baseChange B').pieces i ⊓
   280	            (D.toBasicOpenCoverData.baseChange B').pieces j ⊓
   281	            (D.toBasicOpenCoverData.baseChange B').pieces l ≤
   282	          relCurveMap C B B' ⁻¹ᵁ (D.pieces i ⊓ D.pieces j ⊓ D.pieces l) := by
   283	        rw [Scheme.Hom.preimage_inf]
   284	        exact inf_le_inf (D.toBasicOpenCoverData.baseChange_inf_le_preimage B' i j)
   285	          (D.toBasicOpenCoverData.baseChange_pieces_le_preimage B' l)
   286	      have key := congrArg
   287	        (((relCurveMap C B B').appLE (D.pieces i ⊓ D.pieces j ⊓ D.pieces l)
   288	          ((D.toBasicOpenCoverData.baseChange B').pieces i ⊓
   289	            (D.toBasicOpenCoverData.baseChange B').pieces j ⊓
   290	            (D.toBasicOpenCoverData.baseChange B').pieces l) htriple).hom)
   291	        (D.isGluingCocycle.mul_res i j l)
   292	      rw [map_mul] at key
   293	      have e₁ := (relCurveMap C B B').appLE_resHom
   294	        (inf_le_left : D.pieces i ⊓ D.pieces j ⊓ D.pieces l ≤ D.pieces i ⊓ D.pieces j)
   295	        (D.toBasicOpenCoverData.baseChange_inf_le_preimage B' i j) htriple

     8	/-!
     9	# Canonical pushforward base change for scheme modules
    10	
    11	For a cartesian square of schemes, `canonicalBaseChangeMap` is the Beck--Chevalley mate
    12	
    13	```text
    14	g^* f_* M --> f'_* (g')^* M.
    15	```
    16	
    17	The two coherence theorems identify its pullback followed by the counit with the pullback of
    18	the original counit.  Invertibility is deliberately not asserted here: it is a property of the
    19	module and square, not part of the construction of the canonical map.
    20	-/
    21	
    22	set_option autoImplicit false
    23	
    24	universe u
    25	
    26	open CategoryTheory Limits
    27	
    28	namespace AlgebraicGeometry
    29	
    30	/-- The canonical Beck--Chevalley mate for pushforward along a cartesian square. -/
    31	noncomputable def canonicalBaseChangeMap
    32	    {X X' S S' : Scheme.{u}}
    33	    {f : X ⟶ S} {g : S' ⟶ S} {g' : X' ⟶ X} {f' : X' ⟶ S'}
    34	    (sq : IsPullback g' f' f g) :
    35	    Scheme.Modules.pushforward f ⋙ Scheme.Modules.pullback g ⟶
    36	      Scheme.Modules.pullback g' ⋙ Scheme.Modules.pushforward f' :=
    37	  CategoryTheory.mateEquiv
    38	    (Scheme.Modules.pullbackPushforwardAdjunction f)
    39	    (Scheme.Modules.pullbackPushforwardAdjunction f')
    40	    (((Scheme.Modules.pullbackComp f' g) ≪≫
    41	      Scheme.Modules.pullbackCongr sq.w.symm ≪≫
    42	      (Scheme.Modules.pullbackComp g' f).symm).hom)
    43	
    44	/-- Pulling back the canonical mate and evaluating recovers its defining pullback telescope. -/
    45	theorem canonicalBaseChangeMap_pullback_counit
    46	    {X X' S S' : Scheme.{u}}
    47	    {f : X ⟶ S} {g : S' ⟶ S} {g' : X' ⟶ X} {f' : X' ⟶ S'}
    48	    (sq : IsPullback g' f' f g) (M : X.Modules) :
    49	    (Scheme.Modules.pullback f').map ((canonicalBaseChangeMap sq).app M) ≫
    50	        (Scheme.Modules.pullbackPushforwardAdjunction f').counit.app
    51	          ((Scheme.Modules.pullback g').obj M) =
    52	      ((((Scheme.Modules.pullbackComp f' g) ≪≫
    53	        Scheme.Modules.pullbackCongr sq.w.symm ≪≫
    54	        (Scheme.Modules.pullbackComp g' f).symm).hom).app
    55	          ((Scheme.Modules.pushforward f).obj M)) ≫
    56	        (Scheme.Modules.pullback g').map
    57	          ((Scheme.Modules.pullbackPushforwardAdjunction f).counit.app M) := by
    58	  rw [canonicalBaseChangeMap]
    59	  exact CategoryTheory.mateEquiv_counit _ _ _ M
    60	
    61	/-- After cancelling the pullback telescope, the base-changed counit is the pulled-back
    62	original counit. -/
    63	theorem canonicalBaseChangeMap_counit_cancel
    64	    {X X' S S' : Scheme.{u}}
    65	    {f : X ⟶ S} {g : S' ⟶ S} {g' : X' ⟶ X} {f' : X' ⟶ S'}
    66	    (sq : IsPullback g' f' f g) (M : X.Modules) :
    67	    ((((Scheme.Modules.pullbackComp f' g) ≪≫
    68	      Scheme.Modules.pullbackCongr sq.w.symm ≪≫
    69	      (Scheme.Modules.pullbackComp g' f).symm).inv).app
    70	        ((Scheme.Modules.pushforward f).obj M)) ≫
    71	      ((Scheme.Modules.pullback f').map ((canonicalBaseChangeMap sq).app M) ≫
    72	        (Scheme.Modules.pullbackPushforwardAdjunction f').counit.app
    73	          ((Scheme.Modules.pullback g').obj M)) =
    74	      (Scheme.Modules.pullback g').map
    75	        ((Scheme.Modules.pullbackPushforwardAdjunction f).counit.app M) := by
    76	  erw [canonicalBaseChangeMap_pullback_counit]
    77	  erw [Iso.inv_hom_id_app_assoc]
    78	  rfl
    79	
    80	end AlgebraicGeometry

    47	  ⟨PresheafOfModules.homMk
    48	    { app := fun U ↦ AddCommGrpCat.ofHom <| AddMonoidHom.mk'
    49	        (fun s ↦ D.sectionsMap B' le_rfl s)
    50	        (fun s t ↦ D.sectionsMap_add B' le_rfl s t)
    51	      naturality := fun {U V} i ↦ by
    52	        ext s
    53	        change D.sectionsMap B' le_rfl
    54	            (gluedRes B D.pieces D.unit i.unop.le s) =
    55	          gluedRes B' (D.baseChange B').pieces (D.baseChange B').unit
    56	            (Scheme.Hom.preimage_mono (relCurveMap C B B') i.unop.le)
    57	            (D.sectionsMap B' le_rfl s)
    58	        exact (D.gluedRes_sectionsMap B' i.unop.le le_rfl le_rfl
    59	          (Scheme.Hom.preimage_mono (relCurveMap C B B') i.unop.le) s).symm }
    60	    (fun U r s ↦ by
    61	      change D.sectionsMap B' le_rfl
    62	          (gluedQsmul B D.pieces D.unit le_rfl r s) =
    63	        gluedQsmul B' (D.baseChange B').pieces (D.baseChange B').unit le_rfl
    64	          (((relCurveMap C B B').app U.unop).hom r) (D.sectionsMap B' le_rfl s)
    65	      simpa only [Scheme.Hom.appLE_eq_app] using
    66	        D.sectionsMap_gluedQsmul B'
    67	          (W := U.unop) (W' := relCurveMap C B B' ⁻¹ᵁ U.unop)
    68	          (V := U.unop) (V' := relCurveMap C B B' ⁻¹ᵁ U.unop)
    69	          le_rfl le_rfl le_rfl le_rfl r s)⟩

    71	@[simp]
    72	theorem nativeModuleSectionsMap_app_apply (U : (relCurve C B).Opens)
    73	    (s : Γ(D.nativeModule, U)) :
    74	    (D.nativeModuleSectionsMap B').app U s = D.sectionsMap B' le_rfl s :=
    75	  rfl
    76	
    77	/-- The native module rebuilt from the base-changed datum receives the geometric
    78	pullback of the original native module.  This is adjoint to `sectionsMap` on
    79	every open, with no flatness or finiteness hypothesis on `B → B'`. -/
    80	noncomputable def nativePullbackComparison :
    81	    (Scheme.Modules.pullback (relCurveMap C B B')).obj D.nativeModule ⟶
    82	      (D.baseChange B').nativeModule :=
    83	  ((Scheme.Modules.pullbackPushforwardAdjunction
    84	    (relCurveMap C B B')).homEquiv D.nativeModule
    85	      (D.baseChange B').nativeModule).symm (D.nativeModuleSectionsMap B')
    86	
    87	/-- The adjunct of `nativePullbackComparison` is exactly the morphism assembled
    88	from the datum-level `sectionsMap`. -/
    89	@[simp]
    90	theorem nativePullbackComparison_adjunct :
    91	    (Scheme.Modules.pullbackPushforwardAdjunction
    92	      (relCurveMap C B B')).homEquiv D.nativeModule
    93	        (D.baseChange B').nativeModule (D.nativePullbackComparison B') =
    94	      D.nativeModuleSectionsMap B' := by
    95	  exact Equiv.apply_symm_apply _ _
    96	
    97	end

    99	end BasicOpenCocycleDatum

    36	commutes with restriction.  It therefore gives a morphism from the native module

    47	  ⟨PresheafOfModules.homMk
    48	    { app := fun U ↦ AddCommGrpCat.ofHom <| AddMonoidHom.mk'
    49	        (fun s ↦ D.sectionsMap B' le_rfl s)

    52	        ext s

    54	            (gluedRes B D.pieces D.unit i.unop.le s) =
    55	          gluedRes B' (D.baseChange B').pieces (D.baseChange B').unit

    57	            (D.sectionsMap B' le_rfl s)

    94	      D.nativeModuleSectionsMap B' := by

     6	import AlgebraicJacobian.Picard.Pic0RankOneLocusNative
     7	
     8	/-!
     9	# The canonical native rank-one presentation contract
    10	
    11	`PicRankOneLocalPresentation` deliberately leaves the geometric producer fields explicit.
    12	This file fixes the module part of that contract: for a tied cocycle datum `D`, the module is
    13	always `D.nativeModule` and its base-ring comparison is always
    14	`D.nativeModuleKSheafIso`.  The native piece trivializations supply the line-bundle field;
    15	arbitrary-cartesian pushforward base change and the cohomology/rank certificates stay as
    16	explicit obligations.
    17	
    18	The resulting contract is therefore an adapter interface for a future producer, rather than a
    19	second choice of a line bundle.  Its conversion is consumed directly by the public
    20	`PicRankOneOpen` membership theorem below; no unrelated module or untied class can enter
    21	through this bridge, and the adapter itself does not provide the geometric certificates.
    22	-/
    23	
    24	set_option autoImplicit false
    25	set_option maxSynthPendingDepth 3
    26	
    27	universe u
    28	
    29	open CategoryTheory Limits TopologicalSpace Opposite MonoidalCategory
    30	  CartesianMonoidalCategory
    31	
    32	namespace AlgebraicGeometry
    33	
    34	attribute [local instance] Scheme.overModule Scheme.overSectionsAlgebra
    35	attribute [local instance 10000] relCurve.instOver
    36	
    37	variable {k : Type u} [Field k] {C : Over (Spec (.of k))}
    38	variable [SmoothOfRelativeDimension 1 C.hom] [IsProper C.hom]
    39	  [GeometricallyIrreducible C.hom]
    40	variable {A : Type u} [CommRing A] [Algebra k A]
    41	variable (pi : C.left ⟶ P1 k) [IsFinite pi]
    42	
    43	/-! ## The native adapter contract -/
    44	
    45	/--
    46	A lambda-tied rank-one presentation whose module is canonically the native module of its
    47	cocycle datum.
    48	
    49	The fields after `datum_class` are exactly the remaining producer obligations.  The line-bundle
    50	certificate is derived from the canonical piece trivializations, so a field-level H⁰/H¹
    51	calculation or an unrelated line bundle cannot be silently substituted for the native
    52	evaluation module.
    53	-/
    54	structure PicRankOneNativePresentation
    55	    (lam : picDegLayer C (genus C : ℤ) (overSpec k A)) : Type (u + 1) where
    56	  cover : Algebra.EtaleCover A
    57	  representative : descentClasses C cover
    58	  represents :
    59	    PicEtAff.mk C cover representative = picEtAffineEquiv C A lam.1
    60	  datum : BasicOpenCocycleDatum C cover.Carrier pi
    61	  datum_class :
    62	    (representative : relPic C (overSpec k cover.Carrier)) =
    63	      relPicMk C (overSpec k cover.Carrier) datum.cechPicClass
    64	  native_pushforward_base_change :
    65	    ∀ {T' X' : Scheme.{u}}
    66	      (g : T' ⟶ Spec (.of cover.Carrier)) (f' : X' ⟶ T')
    67	      (g' : X' ⟶ relCurve C cover.Carrier)
    68	      (sq : IsPullback g' f'
    69	        (relCurve C cover.Carrier ↘ Spec (.of cover.Carrier)) g),
    70	      IsIso ((canonicalBaseChangeMap sq).app datum.nativeModule)
    71	  h1_vanishing : Subsingleton (Sheaf.HModule datum.sheaf 1)
    72	  h0_finite : Module.Finite cover.Carrier (Sheaf.HModule datum.sheaf 0)
    73	  h0_projective : Module.Projective cover.Carrier (Sheaf.HModule datum.sheaf 0)
    74	  h0_rank_one :
    75	    ∀ p : PrimeSpectrum cover.Carrier,
    76	      Module.rankAtStalk (Sheaf.HModule datum.sheaf 0) p = 1
    77	
    78	namespace PicRankOneNativePresentation
    79	
    80	variable {pi} {lam : picDegLayer C (genus C : ℤ) (overSpec k A)}
    81	
    82	/-- Convert the native adapter contract to the existing local-presentation contract.
    83	
    84	The two native bridge fields are inserted definitionally; all other fields are transported
    85	without weakening or adding hypotheses.
    86	-/
    87	noncomputable def toLocalPresentation
    88	    (P : PicRankOneNativePresentation pi lam) :
    89	    PicRankOneLocalPresentation pi lam :=
    90	  { cover := P.cover
    91	    representative := P.representative
    92	    represents := P.represents
    93	    datum := P.datum
    94	    datum_class := P.datum_class
    95	    module := P.datum.nativeModule
    96	    module_iso := P.datum.nativeModuleKSheafIso
    97	    line_bundle := P.datum.nativeModule_isLineBundle
    98	    native_pushforward_base_change := P.native_pushforward_base_change
    99	    h1_vanishing := P.h1_vanishing
   100	    h0_finite := P.h0_finite
   101	    h0_projective := P.h0_projective
   102	    h0_rank_one := P.h0_rank_one }
   103	
   104	theorem nonempty_localPresentation
   105	    (P : PicRankOneNativePresentation pi lam) :
   106	    Nonempty (PicRankOneLocalPresentation pi lam) :=
   107	  ⟨P.toLocalPresentation⟩
   108	
   109	end PicRankOneNativePresentation
   110	
   111	/-! ## Immediate rank-one-locus consumer -/
   112	
   113	/--
   114	An arbitrary-affine family of native contracts supplies the existing public rank-one-locus
   115	consumer.  The family is quantified in exactly the same way as
   116	`PicRankOneOpen.LocalPresentationCondition`; the conversion only canonicalizes the module
   117	choice and does not manufacture any of the remaining geometric certificates.
   118	-/
   119	theorem mem_picRankOneOpen_of_nativePresentations
   120	    {T : (Over (Spec (.of k)))ᵒᵖ}
   121	    {lam : (picDegLayerFunctor C (genus C : ℤ)).obj T}
   122	    (h : ∀ (A : Type u) [CommRing A] [Algebra k A]
   123	        (t : overSpec k A ⟶ T.unop),
   124	        Nonempty (PicRankOneNativePresentation pi
   125	          ((picDegLayerFunctor C (genus C : ℤ)).map t.op lam))) :
   126	    lam ∈ (PicRankOneOpen pi).obj T := by
   127	  apply mem_picRankOneOpen_of_localPresentations pi
   128	  intro A _ _ t
   129	  obtain ⟨P⟩ := h A t
   130	  exact P.nonempty_localPresentation
   131	
   132	end AlgebraicGeometry
